race.comment: NASSAU COUNTY (3) is the clear starting point third-up after a sound fourth in a BM65 at this track. His second before that showed the campaign is on track, and the return to BM55 grade with a 1.5kg claim gives him the most persuasive winning profile. FOXY ARTIST (1) is in form, with a win over Instigate followed by a BM50 placing at this track. The 2kg claim and strong track record keep him a live danger. THE WELLIAN (5) comes through the same BM50 at this venue and finished ahead of FOXY ARTIST, with weight relief and a proven track-and-distance record making him a solid hope. MAKANUI (4) has been safely held twice since consistent earlier form, but two wins from six at this track give him a way back into the placings if he rebounds.
